segments.ja543:1.3: Sabbāni te upayantu, dhītaraṃ dehi rājino”.
segments.ja543:2.3: Taṃ vivāhaṃ asaṃyuttaṃ, kathaṃ amhe karomase”.
segments.ja543:3.1: “Jīvitaṃ nūna te cattaṃ, raṭṭhaṃ vā manujādhipa;
segments.ja543:3.3: Na hi nāge kupitamhi, ciraṃ jīvanti tādisā.
segments.ja543:7.3: Bārāṇasiṃ pavajjantu, mā ca kañci [kiñci (sī. pī. ka.)] viheṭhayuṃ”.
segments.ja543:8.3: Rukkhaggesu ca lambantu, vitatā toraṇesu ca.
segments.ja543:10.3: Bārāṇasiṃ pavajjiṃsu, na ca kañci viheṭhayuṃ.
segments.ja543:11.3: Rukkhaggesu ca lambiṃsu, vitatā toraṇesu ca.
segments.ja543:12.1: Tesu disvāna lambante, puthū kandiṃsu nāriyo;
segments.ja543:12.3: Nāge soṇḍikate disvā, passasante muhuṃ muhuṃ.
segments.ja543:15.3: Kā kambukāyūradharā suvatthā, tiṭṭhanti nāriyo dasa vandamānā.
segments.ja543:16.1: “Ko tvaṃ brahābāhu vanassa majjhe, virocasi ghatasittova aggi;
segments.ja543:16.3: Mahesakkho aññatarosi yakkho, udāhu nāgosi mahānubhāvo”.
segments.ja543:17.1: “Nāgohamasmi iddhimā, tejassī [tejasī (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] duratikkamo;
segments.ja543:17.3: Ḍaṃseyyaṃ tejasā kuddho, phītaṃ janapadaṃ api.
segments.ja543:18.1: “Samuddajā hi me mātā, dhataraṭṭho ca me pitā;
segments.ja543:20.3: Yamunaṃ pavisa mā bhīto, khemaṃ vattavataṃ [vattavatiṃ (syā. ka.)] sivaṃ”.
segments.ja543:21.3: Pūjito mayhaṃ kāmehi, sukhaṃ brāhmaṇa vacchasi”.
segments.ja543:22.1: “Samā samantaparito, pahūtatagarā [bahukā taggarā (sī. syā. pī.)] mahī;
segments.ja543:26.3: Iddhī hi tyāyaṃ vipulā, sakkasseva jutīmato”.
segments.ja543:29.3: Taṃ maṃ mataṃ vā jīvaṃ vā, nābhivedenti ñātakā.
segments.ja543:30.3: Tayā no samanuññātā, api passemu ñātake”.
segments.ja543:31.1: “Eso hi vata me chando, yaṃ vasesi mamantike;
segments.ja543:31.3: Na hi etādisā kāmā, sulabhā honti mānuse.
segments.ja543:32.1: “Sace tvaṃ nicchase vatthuṃ, mama kāmehi pūjito;
segments.ja543:32.3: Mayā tvaṃ samanuññāto, sotthiṃ passāhi ñātake”.
segments.ja543:33.1: “Dhārayimaṃ maṇiṃ dibyaṃ, pasuṃ putte ca vindati;
segments.ja543:35.3: Avikampamāno eyyāsi, bahuṃ dassāmi te dhanaṃ”.
segments.ja543:37.3: Etha gacchatha uṭṭhetha, khippaṃ pāpetha brāhmaṇaṃ.
segments.ja543:38.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, uṭṭhāya caturo janā;
segments.ja543:41.3: Ajja kālaṃ pathaṃ [padaṃ (sī. pī.)] gacchaṃ, ajjhagāhaṃ maṇiṃ imaṃ”.
segments.ja543:44.3: Paṭipajja sataṃ nikkhaṃ, dehimaṃ ratanaṃ mama”.
segments.ja543:45.1: “Na ca myāyaṃ maṇī keyyo, gohi [kehi (ka.)] vā ratanehi vā;
segments.ja543:45.3: Selo byañjanasampanno, neva keyyo maṇī mama”.
segments.ja543:46.1: “No ce tayā maṇī keyyo, gohi [kehi (ka.)] vā ratanehi vā;
segments.ja543:46.3: Atha kena maṇī keyyo, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito”.
segments.ja543:47.3: Tassa dajjaṃ imaṃ selaṃ, jalantamiva tejasā”.
segments.ja543:49.1: “Nāhaṃ dijādhipo homi, na diṭṭho garuḷo mayā;
segments.ja543:49.3: Āsīvisena vittoti [vittosmi (syā. ka.)], vajjo brāhmaṇa maṃ vidū”.
segments.ja543:50.1: “Kiṃ nu tuyhaṃ balaṃ atthi, kiṃ sippaṃ vijjate tava;
segments.ja543:50.3: Kismiṃ vā tvaṃ paratthaddho, uragaṃ nāpacāyasi”.
segments.ja543:53.3: Dibbaṃ pātukarī mantaṃ, kāmasā bhagavā mama.
segments.ja543:54.3: Ācariyo visaghātānaṃ, alampānoti [ālambānoti (sī. pī.), ālambāyanoti (syā.)] maṃ vidū”.
segments.ja543:55.3: Mā daṇḍena siriṃ pattaṃ, kāmasā pajahimhase”.
segments.ja543:56.1: “Sakaṃ nivesanaṃ pattaṃ, yo taṃ brāhmaṇa pūjayi;
segments.ja543:57.1: “Sace tvaṃ [sace hi (sī. pī. ka.)] dhanakāmosi, bhūridatto padassati [bhūridattaṃ padissasi (ka.)];
segments.ja543:57.3: Tameva gantvā yācassu, bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ”.
segments.ja543:58.3: Mā no sandiṭṭhiko attho, somadatta upaccagā”.
segments.ja543:59.1: “Paccati niraye ghore, mahissamapi vivarati [mahissamava dīyati (sī. pī.), mahimassa vindrīyati (syā.)];
segments.ja543:59.3: Mittadubbhī hitaccāgī, jīvarevāpi sussati [jīvare cāpi sussare (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja543:60.1: “Sace tvaṃ [sace hi (sī. pī. ka.)] dhanakāmosi, bhūridatto padassati;
segments.ja543:62.1: “Handa dāni apāyāmi, nāhaṃ ajja tayā saha;
segments.ja543:62.3: Padampekaṃ [padamekaṃ (syā. ka.)] na gaccheyyaṃ, evaṃ kibbisakārinā”.
segments.ja543:65.1: “Kappāsapicurāsīva, eso kāyo padissati [kāya’ ssa dissati (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja543:65.3: Vammikaggagato seti, taṃ tvaṃ gaṇhāhi brāhmaṇa”.
segments.ja543:66.3: Evaṃ taṃ asakkhi satthuṃ [saṭṭhuṃ (sī. pī.), yuṭṭhuṃ (syā.), suttuṃ (ka.)], katvā parittamattano”.
segments.ja543:68.3: Indriyāni ahaṭṭhāni, sāvaṃ [sāmaṃ (sī. pī.)] jātaṃ mukhaṃ tava.
segments.ja543:69.3: Sāvaṃ jātaṃ [yantaṃ (ka.)] mukhaṃ tuyhaṃ, mamaṃ disvāna edisaṃ.
segments.ja543:70.1: “Kacci nu te nābhisasi [te nābhisayi (sī.), te nābhissasi (syā.)], kacci te atthi vedanā;
segments.ja543:70.3: Yena sāvaṃ mukhaṃ tuyhaṃ, mamaṃ disvāna āgataṃ”.
segments.ja543:71.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ viya me bāhuṃ, chetvā ruhiramakkhitaṃ;
segments.ja543:71.5: Puriso ādāya pakkāmi, mama rodantiyā sati.
segments.ja543:72.3: Tato divā vā rattiṃ vā, sukhaṃ me nopalabbhati”.
segments.ja543:77.1: “Puttaṃ teyye na jānāma, ito māsaṃ adhogataṃ;
segments.ja543:77.3: Mataṃ vā yadi vā jīvaṃ, bhūridattaṃ yasassinaṃ”.
segments.ja543:78.3: Ciraṃ dukkhena jhāyissaṃ, bhūridattaṃ apassatī [imissā gāthāyānantare sī. pī. potthakesu –“sakuṇī hataputtāva, suññaṃ disvā kulāvakaṃ; tena tena padhāvissa, piyaputtaṃ apassatī”ti iti ayampi gāthā āgatā].
segments.ja543:81.1: “Kammārānaṃ yathā ukkā, anto jhāyati no bahi;
segments.ja543:82.3: Senti puttā ca dārā ca, bhūridattanivesane”.
segments.ja543:83.3: Ariṭṭho ca subhogo [subhago (sī. pī.)] ca, padhāviṃsu anantarā [upadhāviṃsu anantarā (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja543:84.1: “Amma assāsa mā soci, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino;
segments.ja543:86.1: “Ajja ce me imaṃ rattiṃ, sudassana vijānahi;
segments.ja543:88.3: Orena sattarattassa [orena dasarattassa (sī. pī.)], bhātaraṃ passa āgataṃ”.
segments.ja543:89.1: “Hatthā pamutto urago, pāde te nipatī bhusaṃ;
segments.ja543:89.3: Kacci nu taṃ ḍaṃsī tāta [kacci taṃ nu ḍasī tāta (sī.), kacci nu ḍaṃsito tāta (syā.), kaccitānuḍasī tāta (pī.)], mā bhāyi sukhito bhava”.
segments.ja543:90.1: “Neva mayhaṃ ayaṃ nāgo, alaṃ dukkhāya kāyaci;
segments.ja543:90.3: Yāvatatthi ahiggāho, mayā bhiyyo na vijjati”.
segments.ja543:91.1: “Ko nu brāhmaṇavaṇṇena, ditto [datto (sī. syā. pī.)] parisamāgato;
segments.ja543:92.3: Hotu no abbhutaṃ tattha, āsahassehi pañcahi”.
segments.ja543:93.3: Ko nu te pāṭibhogatthi, upajūtañca kiṃ siyā.
segments.ja543:94.3: Hotu no abbhutaṃ tattha, āsahassehi pañcahi”.
segments.ja543:95.3: Pañcannaṃ me sahassānaṃ, pāṭibhogo hi kittima”.
segments.ja543:96.1: “Pettikaṃ vā iṇaṃ hoti, yaṃ vā hoti sayaṃkataṃ;
segments.ja543:96.3: Kiṃ tvaṃ evaṃ bahuṃ mayhaṃ, dhanaṃ yācasi brāhmaṇa”.
segments.ja543:97.1: “Alampāno hi nāgena, mamaṃ abhijigīsati [abhijigiṃsati (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja543:100.3: Avisena ca nāgena, bhusaṃ vañcayase janaṃ.
segments.ja543:101.1: “Evaṃ cetaṃ jano jaññā, yathā jānāmi taṃ ahaṃ;
segments.ja543:101.3: Na tvaṃ labhasi ālampa, bhusamuṭṭhiṃ [thusamuṭṭhiṃ (syā.), sattumuṭṭhiṃ (sī. pī.)] kuto dhanaṃ”.
segments.ja543:102.1: “Kharājino jaṭī dummī [rummī (sī. syā. pī.)], ditto parisamāgato;
segments.ja543:102.3: Yo tvaṃ evaṃ gataṃ nāgaṃ, aviso atimaññasi.
segments.ja543:103.1: “Āsajja kho naṃ jaññāsi, puṇṇaṃ uggassa tejaso;
segments.ja543:105.3: Idha dānāni datvāna, saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā;
segments.ja543:105.5: Jīvanto dehi dānāni, yadi te atthi dātave.
segments.ja543:106.3: Tena taṃ ḍaṃsayissāmi, so taṃ bhasmaṃ karissati”.
segments.ja543:107.3: Idha dānāni datvāna, saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā;
segments.ja543:107.5: Tvameva dehi jīvanto, yadi te atthi dātave.
segments.ja543:108.1: “Ayaṃ ajamukhī [accimukhī (sī. syā. pī.)] nāma, puṇṇā uggassa tejaso;
segments.ja543:108.3: Tāya taṃ ḍaṃsayissāmi, sā taṃ bhasmaṃ karissati”.
segments.ja543:109.3: Sā taṃ ḍaṃsatvajamukhī [sā dissatu accimukhī (sī. pī.)], puṇṇā uggassa tejaso”.
segments.ja543:111.3: Satta vassāniyaṃ devo, na vasse na himaṃ pate.
segments.ja543:112.3: Yāvantodakajā [yāvatā odakā (sī.), yāvatā udakajā (pī.)] pāṇā, mareyyuṃ macchakacchapā”.
segments.ja543:114.3: Komaṃ ajjhoharī bhūto, ogāḷhaṃ yamunaṃ nadiṃ”.
segments.ja543:115.1: “Yadesa lokādhipatī yasassī, bārāṇasiṃ pakriya [pakiraparī (sī. pī.), pakiraharī (syā.)] samantato;
segments.ja543:115.3: Tassāha putto uragūsabhassa, subhogoti maṃ brāhmaṇa vedayanti”.
segments.ja543:116.1: “Sace hi putto uragūsabhassa, kāsissa [kaṃsassa (sī. pī.)] rañño amarādhipassa;
segments.ja543:116.3: Mahesakkho aññataro pitā te, maccesu mātā pana te atulyā;
segments.ja543:116.5: Na tādiso arahati brāhmaṇassa, dāsampi ohārituṃ [ohātuṃ (sī. pī.)] mahānubhāvo”.
segments.ja543:117.3: So viddho dūramacari [dūra’ masarā (sī. pī.)], saravegena sīghavā [sekhavā (sī. pī.), pekkhavā (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja543:120.1: “Tattha te so pāturahu, iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ;
segments.ja543:121.3: Aduṭṭhassa tuvaṃ dubbhi, taṃ te veraṃ idhāgataṃ.
segments.ja543:122.1: “Khippaṃ gīvaṃ pasārehi, na te dassāmi jīvitaṃ;
segments.ja543:122.3: Bhātu parisaraṃ veraṃ, chedayissāmi te siraṃ”.
segments.ja543:123.3: Etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, avajjho hoti [bhavati (sī. syā. pī.)] brāhmaṇo”.
segments.ja543:125.3: Yathā te tattha vakkhanti, tathā hessasi brāhmaṇa”.
segments.ja543:127.1: “Anittarā ittarasampayuttā, yaññā ca vedā ca subhogaloke;
segments.ja543:127.3: Tadaggarayhañhi vinindamāno, jahāti vittañca satañca dhammaṃ.
segments.ja543:128.1: “Ajjhenamariyā pathaviṃ janindā, vessā kasiṃ pāricariyañca suddā;
segments.ja543:128.3: Upāgu paccekaṃ yathāpadesaṃ, katāhu ete vasināti āhu”.
segments.ja543:129.1: “Dhātā vidhātā varuṇo kuvero, somo yamo candimā vāyu sūriyo;
segments.ja543:129.3: Etepi yaññaṃ puthuso yajitvā, ajjhāyakānaṃ atho sabbakāme.
segments.ja543:130.1: “Vikāsitā cāpasatāni pañca, yo ajjuno balavā bhīmaseno;
segments.ja543:130.3: Sahassabāhu asamo pathabyā, sopi tadā mādahi jātavedaṃ”.
segments.ja543:131.1: “Yo brāhmaṇe bhojayi dīgharattaṃ, annena pānena yathānubhāvaṃ;
segments.ja543:132.1: “Mahāsanaṃ devamanomavaṇṇaṃ, yo sappinā asakkhi bhojetumaggiṃ [jetumaggiṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja543:132.3: Sa yaññatantaṃ varato yajitvā, dibbaṃ gatiṃ mucalindajjhagacchi”.
segments.ja543:133.3: Hitvā apariyantaraṭṭhaṃ [rathaṃ (sī. pī.)] sasenaṃ, rājā dudīpopi jagāma [dudīpopajjhagāmi (syā.)] saggaṃ”.
segments.ja543:134.1: “Yo sāgarantaṃ sāgaro vijitvā, yūpaṃ subhaṃ soṇṇamayaṃ [sovaṇṇamayaṃ (syā. ka.)] uḷāraṃ;
segments.ja543:135.1: “Yassānubhāvena subhoga gaṅgā, pavattatha [pavattati (syā. ka.)] dadhisannisinnaṃ [dadhisanna (sī. pī.)] samuddaṃ;
segments.ja543:136.3: So somayāgena malaṃ vihantvā, subhoga devaññataro ahosi”.
segments.ja543:137.1: “Akārayi lokamimaṃ parañca, bhāgīrathiṃ himavantañca gijjhaṃ [gijjhaṃ (syā. ka.), viñjhaṃ (?)];
segments.ja543:137.3: Yo iddhimā devavaro yasassī, sopi tadā ādahi jātavedaṃ.
segments.ja543:138.1: “Mālāgirī himavā yo ca gijjho [vijjho (ka.), vijjhā (syā.)], sudassano nisabho kuveru [kākaneru (sī. pī.), kākaveru (syā.)];
segments.ja543:138.3: Ete ca aññe ca nagā mahantā, cityā katā yaññakarehi māhu”.
segments.ja543:139.1: “Ajjhāyakaṃ mantaguṇūpapannaṃ, tapassinaṃ yācayogotidhāhu [ticāha (sī. pī.), ti cāhu (ka.)];
segments.ja543:140.3: Purimaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ dakkhiṇuttaraṃ, saṃvijjamānā janayanti vedaṃ”.
segments.ja543:141.1: “Kalī hi dhīrāna kaṭaṃ magānaṃ, bhavanti vedajjhagatānariṭṭha;
segments.ja543:142.1: “Vedā na tāṇāya bhavanti dassa, mittadduno bhūnahuno narassa;
segments.ja543:142.3: Na tāyate pariciṇṇo ca aggi, dosantaraṃ maccamanariyakammaṃ.
segments.ja543:143.1: “Sabbañca maccā sadhanaṃ sabhogaṃ [sadhanā sabhogā (sī. syā. pī. ka.)], ādīpitaṃ dāru tiṇena missaṃ;
segments.ja543:143.3: Dahaṃ na tappe [na tappe aggi (ka.)] asamatthatejo, ko taṃ subhikkhaṃ dvirasaññu kayirā [dirasañña kuriyā (sī.), dirasaññu kuriyā (pī.)].
segments.ja543:144.1: “Yathāpi khīraṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, dadhi bhavitvā navanītampi hoti;
segments.ja543:144.3: Evampi aggi vipariṇāmadhammo, tejo samorohatī yogayutto.
segments.ja543:145.1: “Na dissatī aggimanuppaviṭṭho, sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi;
segments.ja543:145.3: Nāmatthamāno [nāmanthamāno (sī. pī.)] araṇīnarena, nākammunā jāyati jātavedo.
segments.ja543:146.1: “Sace hi aggi antarato vaseyya, sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi;
segments.ja543:146.3: Sabbāni susseyyu vanāni loke, sukkhāni kaṭṭhāni ca pajjaleyyuṃ.
segments.ja543:147.1: “Karoti ce dārutiṇena puññaṃ, bhojaṃ naro dhūmasikhiṃ patāpavaṃ;
segments.ja543:147.3: Aṅgārikā loṇakarā ca sūdā, sarīradāhāpi kareyyu puññaṃ.
segments.ja543:148.1: “Atha ce hi ete na karonti puññaṃ, ajjhenamaggiṃ idha tappayitvā;
segments.ja543:148.3: Na koci lokasmiṃ karoti puññaṃ, bhojaṃ naro dhūmasikhiṃ patāpavaṃ.
segments.ja543:149.3: Yadeva maccā parivajjayanti, tadappasatthaṃ dvirasaññu bhuñje.
segments.ja543:150.1: “Sikhimpi devesu vadanti heke, āpaṃ milakkhū [milakkhā (sī. pī.)] pana devamāhu;
segments.ja543:150.3: Sabbeva ete vitathaṃ bhaṇanti [gaṇhanti (ka.)], aggī na devaññataro na cāpo.
segments.ja543:151.1: “Anindriyabaddhamasaññakāyaṃ [nirindriyaṃ antaṃ asaññakāyaṃ (sī. pī.), anidriyaṃ santamasaññakāyaṃ (syā.)], vessānaraṃ kammakaraṃ pajānaṃ;
segments.ja543:151.3: Paricariya maggiṃ sugatiṃ kathaṃ vaje, pāpāni kammāni pakubbamāno [pakūbbamāno (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja543:152.3: Sabbānubhāvī ca vasī kimatthaṃ, animmito nimmitaṃ vanditassa.
segments.ja543:153.3: Te lābhasakkāre apātubhonte, sandhāpitā [santhambhitā (sī. pī.), sandhābhitā (syā.), santāpitā (ka.)] jantubhi santidhammaṃ.
segments.ja543:154.1: “Ajjhenamariyā pathaviṃ janindā, vessā kasiṃ pāricariyañca suddā;
segments.ja543:154.3: Upāgu paccekaṃ yathāpadesaṃ, katāhu ete vasināti āhu.
segments.ja543:155.1: “Etañca saccaṃ vacanaṃ bhaveyya, yathā idaṃ bhāsitaṃ brāhmaṇehi;
segments.ja543:155.3: Nākhattiyo jātu labhetha rajjaṃ, nābrāhmaṇo mantapadāni sikkhe;
segments.ja543:155.5: Nāññatra vessehi kasiṃ kareyya, suddo na mucce parapesanāya [parapessitāya (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja543:156.1: “Yasmā ca etaṃ vacanaṃ abhūtaṃ, musāvime odariyā bhaṇanti;
segments.ja543:156.3: Tadappapaññā abhisaddahanti, passanti taṃ paṇḍitā attanāva.
segments.ja543:157.1: “Khatyā hi vessānaṃ [khattā na vessā na (sī. pī.)] baliṃ haranti, ādāya satthāni caranti brāhmaṇā;
segments.ja543:157.3: Taṃ tādisaṃ saṅkhubhitaṃ pabhinnaṃ, kasmā brahmā nujju karoti lokaṃ.
segments.ja543:158.1: “Sace hi so issaro sabbaloke, brahmā bahūbhūtapatī [brahmapahū bhūtapatī (syā.)] pajānaṃ;
segments.ja543:158.3: Kiṃ sabbalokaṃ vidahī alakkhiṃ, kiṃ sabbalokaṃ na sukhiṃ akāsi.
segments.ja543:159.1: “Sace hi so issaro sabbaloke, brahmā bahūbhūtapatī pajānaṃ;
segments.ja543:159.3: Māyā musāvajjamadena [musāvañcanapadena (ka.)] cāpi, lokaṃ adhammena kimatthamakāri [kimattha’ kāsi (sī. pī.), kimatthakārī (syā.)].
segments.ja543:160.1: “Sace hi so issaro sabbaloke, brahmā bahūbhūtapatī pajānaṃ;
segments.ja543:160.3: Adhammiko bhūtapatī ariṭṭha, dhamme sati yo vidahī adhammaṃ.
segments.ja543:161.1: “Kīṭā paṭaṅgā uragā ca bhekā [bhiṅgā (syā.)], hantvā kimī sujjhati makkhikā ca;
segments.ja543:161.3: Etepi dhammā anariyarūpā, kambojakānaṃ vitathā bahūnaṃ.
segments.ja543:162.1: “Sace hi so sujjhati yo hanāti, hatopi so saggamupeti ṭhānaṃ;
segments.ja543:162.3: Bhovādi bhovādina mārayeyyuṃ [mārabheyyuṃ (ka.)], ye cāpi tesaṃ abhisaddaheyyuṃ.
segments.ja543:163.1: “Neva migā na pasū nopi gāvo, āyācanti attavadhāya keci;
segments.ja543:163.3: Vipphandamāne idha jīvikatthā, yaññesu pāṇe pasumārabhanti [māharanti (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja543:164.1: “Yūpussane [yūpassa te (sī.), yūpassa ne (pī.)] pasubandhe ca bālā, cittehi vaṇṇehi mukhaṃ nayanti;
segments.ja543:164.3: Ayaṃ te yūpo kāmaduho parattha, bhavissati sassato samparāye.
segments.ja543:165.1: “Sace ca yūpe maṇisaṅkhamuttaṃ, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ;
segments.ja543:165.3: Sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi, sace duhe tidive sabbakāme;
segments.ja543:165.5: Tevijjasaṅghāva puthū yajeyyuṃ, abrāhmaṇaṃ [na brāhmaṇā (sī. syā.)] kañci na yājayeyyuṃ.
segments.ja543:166.1: “Kuto ca yūpe maṇisaṅkhamuttaṃ, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ;
segments.ja543:166.3: Sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi, kuto duhe tidive sabbakāme.
segments.ja543:167.1: “Saṭhā ca luddā ca paluddhabālā [upaladdhabālā (sī. pī.)], cittehi vaṇṇehi mukhaṃ nayanti;
segments.ja543:167.3: Ādāya aggiṃ mama dehi vittaṃ, tato sukhī hohisi sabbakāme.
segments.ja543:168.1: “Tamaggihuttaṃ saraṇaṃ pavissa, cittehi vaṇṇehi mukhaṃ nayanti;
segments.ja543:168.3: Oropayitvā kesamassuṃ nakhañca, vedehi vittaṃ atigāḷhayanti [atigāḷayanti (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja543:169.1: “Kākā ulūkaṃva raho labhitvā, ekaṃ samānaṃ bahukā samecca;
segments.ja543:169.3: Annāni bhutvā kuhakā kuhitvā, muṇḍaṃ karitvā yaññapathossajanti.
segments.ja543:170.1: “Evañhi so vañcito brāhmaṇehi, eko samāno bahukā [bahuhī (sī.)] samecca;
segments.ja543:170.3: Te yogayogena vilumpamānā, diṭṭhaṃ adiṭṭhena dhanaṃ haranti.
segments.ja543:171.3: Te tādisā corasamā asantā, vajjhā na haññanti ariṭṭha loke.
segments.ja543:172.3: Taṃ cepi saccaṃ maghavā chinnabāhu, kenassa indo asure jināti.
segments.ja543:173.1: “Tañceva tucchaṃ maghavā samaṅgī, hantā avajjho paramo sa devo [sudevo (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja543:173.3: Mantā ime brāhmaṇā tuccharūpā, sandiṭṭhikā vañcanā esa loke.
segments.ja543:174.1: “Mālāgiri himavā yo ca gijjho, sudassano nisabho kuveru;
segments.ja543:174.3: Ete ca aññe ca nagā mahantā, cityā katā yaññakarehi māhu.
segments.ja543:175.1: “Yathāpakārāni hi iṭṭhakāni, cityā katā yaññakarehi māhu;
segments.ja543:175.3: Na pabbatā honti tathāpakārā, aññā disā acalā tiṭṭhaselā.
segments.ja543:176.1: “Na iṭṭhakā honti silā cirena [cirenapi (sī. pī.)], na tattha sañjāyati ayo na lohaṃ;
segments.ja543:176.3: Yaññañca etaṃ parivaṇṇayantā, cityā katā yaññakarehi māhu.
segments.ja543:177.3: Tīre samuddassudakaṃ sajantaṃ, taṃ sāgarojjhohari tenapeyyo.
segments.ja543:178.3: Na tena byāpannarasūdakā na, kasmā samuddo atulo apeyyo.
segments.ja543:179.1: “Ye keci kūpā idha jīvaloke, loṇūdakā kūpakhaṇehi khātā;
segments.ja543:179.3: Na brāhmaṇajjhoharaṇena [brāhmaṇajjhohari tena (ka.)] tesu, āpo apeyyo dvirasaññu māhu.
segments.ja543:180.1: “Pure puratthā kā kassa bhariyā, mano manussaṃ ajanesi pubbe;
segments.ja543:180.3: Tenāpi dhammena na koci hīno, evampi vossaggavibhaṅgamāhu [vossaggavibhāgamāhu (sī.)].
segments.ja543:181.1: “Caṇḍālaputtopi adhicca vede, bhāseyya mante kusalo matīmā [mutīmā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja543:181.3: Na tassa muddhāpi phaleyya sattadhā, mantā ime attavadhāya katā [katta (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja543:182.3: Bālāna cittaṃ visame niviṭṭhaṃ, tadappapaññā abhisaddahanti.
segments.ja543:183.1: “Sīhassa byagghassa ca dīpino ca, na vijjatī porisiyaṃbalena;
segments.ja543:183.3: Manussabhāvo ca gavaṃva pekkho, jātī hi tesaṃ asamā samānā [samānaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja543:184.1: “Sace ca rājā pathaviṃ vijitvā, sajīvavā assavapārisajjo;
segments.ja543:184.3: Sayameva so sattusaṅghaṃ vijeyya, tassappajā niccasukhī [niccasukhā (pī.)] bhaveyya.
segments.ja543:185.1: “Khattiyamantā ca tayo ca vedā, atthena ete samakā bhavanti;
segments.ja543:185.3: Tesañca atthaṃ avinicchinitvā, na bujjhatī oghapathaṃva channaṃ.
segments.ja543:186.1: “Khattiyamantā ca tayo ca vedā, atthena ete samakā bhavanti;
segments.ja543:186.3: Lābho alābho ayaso yaso ca, sabbeva tesaṃ catunnañca [sabbe te sabbesaṃ catunna (sī. pī.)] dhammā.
segments.ja543:187.1: “Yathāpi ibbhā dhanadhaññahetu, kammāni karonti [kārenti (sī. syā. pī.)] puthū pathabyā;
segments.ja543:187.3: Tevijjasaṅghā ca tatheva ajja, kammāni karonti [kārenti (sī. syā. pī.)] puthū pathabyā.
segments.ja543:188.1: “Ibbhehi ye te [ete (sī. syā. pī.)] samakā bhavanti, niccussukā kāmaguṇesu yuttā;
segments.ja543:188.3: Kammāni karonti [kārenti (sī. syā. pī.)] puthū pathabyā, tadappapaññā dvirasaññurā te”.
segments.ja543:191.3: Yuvā kalāpasannaddho, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
segments.ja543:192.3: Mukhañca rucirā bhāti, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
segments.ja543:194.3: Ubhato varapuññassa [carate varapaññassa (sī. pī.)], muddhani uparūpari.
segments.ja543:195.3: Kañcanamaṇidaṇḍāni [tapaññamaṇidaṇḍāni (sī. pī.), suvaṇṇamaṇidaṇḍāni (syā. ka.)], caranti dubhato mukhaṃ.
segments.ja543:196.3: Kassete kuṇḍalā vaggū, sobhanti dubhato mukhaṃ.
segments.ja543:197.1: “Kassa vātena chupitā, niddhantā mudukāḷakā [mudukāḷakaṃ (sī.), mudu kāḷikā (syā.)];
segments.ja543:198.3: Ko sobhati visālakkho, kassetaṃ uṇṇajaṃ mukhaṃ.
segments.ja543:200.3: Ko so bimboṭṭhasampanno, divā sūriyova bhāsati.
segments.ja543:201.3: Ko so odātapāvāro, jayaṃ indova sobhati.
segments.ja543:202.3: Ko so parisamogayha, īsaṃ khaggaṃ pamuñcati [īso khaggaṃva muñcati (sī. pī.), bhante khaggaṃ pamuñcati (syā.)].
segments.ja543:203.3: Ko so omuñcate pādā, namo katvā mahesino”.
